app.name: Almali Library Curator for Plex
app.tagline: Shows what nobody watches in a Plex library, and removes only what you mark.

detection.reason.never_watched.series: Added {date}. 0 episodes played by any of the {users} users.
detection.reason.never_watched.movie: Added {date}. 0 plays by any of the {users} users.
detection.reason.cancelled.played: Cancelled in {year}. Last play {date}, nobody mid-season.
detection.reason.cancelled.never_played: Cancelled in {year}. Never played, nobody mid-season.
detection.reason.not_rewatched.once: Watched once by {name} in {date}. Nobody since.
detection.reason.not_rewatched.twice: Watched twice by {name} in {date}. Nobody since.
detection.reason.not_rewatched.times: Watched {count} times by {names} in {date}. Nobody since.
protection.reason.rating: Rated {rating}, at or above the minimum of {minimum}.
removal.failed.interrupted: Removal failed: deletion was interrupted and must pass the final check again.
removal.failed.empty_scope: Removal failed: no files could be identified for this scope.
removal.failed.files_unknown: Removal failed: file status could not be verified on disk.
removal.failed.files_present: Removal failed: files are still present on disk.
removal.failed.seasons_missing: Removal failed: the season rows of this scope are missing, so its exact scope can no longer be verified.
removal.failed.service: Removal failed: the removal service reported an error.
removal.failed.radarr_identity: Removal failed: this movie is not linked to Radarr, so Radarr cannot remove it. Link it in Radarr, or switch Radarr deletions off to let Plex remove it.
removal.failed.sonarr_identity: Removal failed: this series is not linked to Sonarr, so Sonarr cannot remove it. Link it in Sonarr, or switch Sonarr deletions off to let Plex remove it.
removal.failed.plex_refused: Removal failed: Plex refused to delete the media. Turn on "Allow media deletion" in the Plex server settings.
removal.failed.plex_auth: Removal failed: Plex rejected the token.
removal.failed.plex_unavailable: Removal failed: Plex could not be reached.
removal.cancel.undo: Removal cancelled: the marking was undone.
removal.cancel.keep_it: Removal cancelled: the owner chose to keep it.
removal.cancel.no_longer_matches: Removal cancelled: it no longer matches its category.
removal.cancel.not_curated: Removal cancelled: its library is no longer curated.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.plex_intro: Plex is the only required connection. It provides the libraries, the users and the watch history.
setup.libraries_intro: Choose the libraries that are never touched.
setup.libraries_curated_intro: Choose which libraries the app curates. Unchecked libraries are never scanned, shown or touched.
setup.no_libraries: No libraries yet. Connect Plex and run a scan, then come back to this step.
setup.connections_intro: Sonarr, Radarr, Tautulli, TMDB and the host paths are optional; each one adds facts or actions when present.
web.flash.marked: Marked for removal. The grace period has started.
web.flash.keep_forever: Kept forever. It will not become a candidate again.
web.flash.duplicate_mark: It is already marked for removal.
web.flash.protected: It is protected and cannot be marked.
web.flash.grace_range: Grace period must be between 3 and 60 days.
web.flash.request_state: That removal can no longer be changed.
web.flash.invalid_scope: That item or season selection is not valid.
web.flash.not_candidate: It no longer matches any category. Nothing was changed.
web.flash.not_curated: Its library is not curated, so it cannot be marked. Nothing was changed.
web.flash.action_failed: The action could not be completed. Check the connections and try again.
web.form.grace_range: Grace period must be between 3 and 60 days.
web.form.rating_range: Minimum rating must be between 0 and 10.
web.form.threshold_range: Thresholds must be whole months, 1 or more.
web.form.secrets_unsupported: Keys and tokens cannot be changed here.
web.form.unreadable: This removal request could not be read.
web.form.protected_not_curated: A protected library must also be curated. Tick its curated box first.
connections.plex.title: Plex connection
connections.plex.token_help: To find your token, open any item in Plex Web, choose Get Info, then View XML: the token is the X-Plex-Token value in the address bar.
connections.plex.token_stored: A token is stored ({mask}). Leave the field empty to keep it.
connections.plex.env_managed: Plex is managed by the ALC_PLEX_BASE_URL and ALC_PLEX_TOKEN environment variables, so it cannot be changed here.
connections.plex.token_unreadable: The stored Plex token could not be read. Enter the token again.
connections.plex.signin.intro: Open Plex, enter the code, and this app saves the connection for you. You can also type the address and token by hand below.
connections.plex.signin.waiting: Waiting for your Plex authorization. Open the link and enter the code; this page checks automatically.
connections.plex.signin.cancelled: The Plex sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was stored.
connections.plex.signin.authorized: Your Plex account is connected. Now choose which of your servers this app should use.
connections.plex.signin.succeeded: Signed in to Plex. The token and the server address are saved.
web.form.plex_address: Enter an http:// or https:// address with a host, without a user name, query or fragment.
web.form.plex_token_invalid: A Plex token has no spaces or special characters. Copy it again.
web.form.plex_unreachable: Plex could not be reached at that address. Nothing was saved.
web.form.plex_token_refused: Plex refused the token. Nothing was saved.
web.form.plex_not_a_server: That address answered, but not as a Plex Media Server. Nothing was saved.
web.form.plex_signin_refused: Plex refused the sign-in request. Nothing was stored.
web.form.plex_signin_expired: The sign-in code expired. Start the sign-in again.
web.form.plex_signin_unreachable: plex.tv could not be reached, so the sign-in cannot continue. Nothing was stored.
web.form.plex_resources_unreachable: Your servers could not be read from plex.tv. Enter the address by hand.
web.flash.plex_signin_pending: A Plex sign-in is already waiting. Cancel it, or choose a server, before starting another.
